# I Believe Tools

## Company

Danyang I Believe Machinery Tools Co., Ltd. manufactures diamond saw blades in the Danyang Economic Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, China.

## Core products

- Diamond saw blades for tile, porcelain, granite, marble, concrete, asphalt, and tuck pointing.
- Bonds in the catalog: sintered and hot-pressed, laser welded, vacuum brazed.
- Matching tools: diamond cup wheels and diamond core bits.

## Capabilities

- Founded: 2014.
- Factory area: 3000 square meters.
- Stated annual capacity: more than 2 million pieces.
- Brochure certifications: ISO 9001:2000 and German MPA safety and quality certification.
- Buyers the site is written for: Europe, India, Central Asia, and the Middle East.
